title: accelerate-release-note-drafting-with-priority-ledgers-and-review-sprints
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Release note cycles are taking too long for releases that touch Dedicated and Private deployments. We need a repeatable, time-boxed process to draft both internal and customer-facing release notes with clear prioritization, redaction guidance, localization handoff, and stakeholder signoffs.

Goal: Build a lightweight workflow (priority ledger + two 60-minute review sprints) that reduces draft-to-final time to <= 3 business days for standard releases and preserves embargo controls for sensitive items. Deliver artifacts: priority ledger template, review-sprint checklist, executive one-pager template, localized blurb format, and automation spec for creating PRDs/notes in Confluence from the ledger.

Scope: Applies to product and platform releases with customer-visible behavior changes (API, SDK, console, Dedicated/Private). Excludes major regulatory/legal-only notices which follow the compliance runbook.

Acceptance criteria:
- Priority ledger template adopted by PMs and ENG leads for two pilot releases.
- Two review sprints executed with cross-functional attendees and recorded action items.
- Final customer-facing changelog drafted, redacted per legal, and localized strings handed to i18n.
- Exec one-pager produced and validated by Marketing and CS.

Out of scope: full translation management system (we handoff to localization), deep legal review of every item (only items flagged in ledger).
